d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Delhi’s familiar winter pollution crisis ahead of Diwali has returned with alarming speed, pushing the National Capital Region to the brink of the 'severe' air quality zone. In less than a week, the city's Air Quality Index experienced a six-fold surge, hitting 377—its worst reading in nearly ten months. Data points to stubble burning in neighbouring states and dense local vehicular emissions as the primary culprits, while coarse road dust takes over as the dominant pollutant.
